title: Eventtick Service Overview
description: Phase 14 Step 3 — minimal overview built only from metrics the existing Spring Boot Actuator/Micrometer setup actually exposes (see docs/architecture.md §46.4). Queries the local Prometheus datasource provisioned alongside this dashboard.

panels.title: HTTP request rate
panels.description: Requests/second per service, from http_server_requests_seconds_count. For gateway-service, most proxied routes report uri="UNKNOWN" (Spring Cloud Gateway's WebFlux metrics only resolve a real uri for the gateway's own local endpoints, e.g. /actuator/health) — this panel sums by service, not by uri, so that limitation doesn't affect it.

panels.title: HTTP request latency (average)
panels.description: Average request duration per service: rate(sum)/rate(count) over http_server_requests_seconds. This is a MEAN, not a percentile — the app does not expose _bucket series (management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram was not enabled in Phase 14), so histogram_quantile() cannot be used here. See docs/architecture.md §46.4 for this documented limitation.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx error rate
panels.description: Server-error responses/second per service (status=~"5.."), from the same http_server_requests_seconds_count series as the request-rate panel.

panels.title: JVM heap memory used
panels.description: Sum of jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="heap"} per service (all heap pools combined — G1 Eden/Old/Survivor on this project's JVM).

panels.title: Process CPU usage
panels.description: process_cpu_usage per service — the JVM process's own recent CPU usage as a 0-1 fraction (Micrometer's standard process metric, not a custom one).
